newsitem.title: USA: Vans stake of 6.0 pct held by N.Y. group.
newsitem.headline: Vans stake of 6.0 pct held by N.Y. group.

text.p: A group including Zweig-DiMenna Partners L.P., an investment partnership based in New York, said Friday it holds a six percent stake, or 784,000 common shares, in Vans Inc.
In a fiilng with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $11.2 million for the stake and holds it for investment purposes.
It said its stake includes a net of 602,500 shares purchased between October 24 to December 30 at prices ranging from $11.125 to $18.375 a share.
Vans is an Orange, Calif.,-based maker of casual shoes.
